runs.summary: I read shop/export.py and store.list_customers. I ran tests/test_export.py, and all 6 tests pass. The diff meets both Done Contract items: the header row, one row per customer, and the sort by id. Nothing blocks the merge. I raised one advisory about spreadsheet formulas in names.

findings.claim: customers_csv writes the free-text customer name unescaped. A customer named `=HYPERLINK(...)` or `=cmd|...` becomes a formula when Finance opens the CSV in Excel (CSV formula injection). The orders CSV has no free-text field, so this is the first export with the problem. Consider prefixing values that start with = + - @ with a quote.
findings.check: A test that saves a customer named "=1+1" and asserts the exported cell does not start with "=".
